zh: 与桌面版对齐：AI 月报可以把一份报告设为「默认显示」，打开页面先显示它并排在列表最前；智能体新增临期 / 超期催办明细查询（和一键催办同一份数据，只读）；工具设置页改为固定列宽的表格；修复 AI BI 和月报的报告菜单在名称较长时溢出、侧栏禁用项提示不消失、项目分组折叠状态被搜索打乱。
en: Aligned with the desktop edition: an AI monthly report can be starred as the default, opening first and listed on top; the agent can look up upcoming and overdue follow-ups (read-only, same data as one-click reminders); the tool settings page uses a fixed-width table; fixed long names overflowing the AI BI and monthly report menus, disabled sidebar hints not dismissing, and project folding being reset by search.
